items.title: Flatness of a module over the base local ring and over the local ring of an etale cover are equivalent
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter flat.tex (More on Flatness)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file flat.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma transfers flatness across an etale morphism at the level of local rings: for a module over the local ring of a point of the cover, flatness over the base local ring and over the local ring of the cover are equivalent (statement lines 159-168, tag 05BA). The proof reduces to affine neighbourhoods, realizes the module as the stalk at $t$ of a quasi-coherent sheaf pushed forward from the spectrum of the local ring, and applies the affine form of the criterion. The reduction and the transport of the module are the substance, so the claim is H2.
